name: v4_reward_paper_protocol

proposed_method.name: FA-HPPO with normalized time-horizon reward
proposed_method.architecture: frozen V3 FA-HPPO (time-aware envelope, Beta amount head, same PPO config)

relationship_to_prior_stages.v1_v2_v3: frozen evidence untouched; V3 TEST remains consumed and is not reused
relationship_to_prior_stages.v4_reward_development: TRAIN/VAL reward ablation under results/v4_reward/; PBRS retained as negative/neutral ablation

primary_comparison.note: Both evaluated on the identical fresh V4 TEST corpus

confirmatory_test.certificate_procedure: identical to V3 SynthCharge paper TEST (charging certificate search; classify_route)

paired_analyses_predeclared: V4_FA_HPPO vs V3_FA_HPPO feasibility win/tie/loss on matched route x seed
V4 vs V3 failure-retaining completion on all routes
V4 vs V3 operational metrics on matched common-feasible subset
stratified by layout, customer scale, charging-required, layout x difficulty
development_selection_wording: V4_BASE_NO_L_FAIL matched the best mean development feasibility and obtained the lowest mean failure-retaining completion among the tied variants. Effects across seeds were variable, so the reward is selected primarily for its simple objective-consistent formulation rather than claimed as a large performance improvement.
conservative_message: The normalized time-horizon reward provides a simpler objective-aligned formulation without arbitrary weighted penalties. Development evidence showed no meaningful feasibility advantage from PBRS, so the simpler reward was selected and evaluated prospectively on a fresh held-out TEST.
